verdict.rationale: x402 is agent-native by design: agents can discover services via MCP tool calls, hold funds via agentic accounts, and autonomously pay mid-task rather than through a GUI, which functionally lets AI-native users operate payments through their agent's natural-language-driven tool calls (coinbase-x402-docs-14, coinbase-x402-docs-11, coinbase-x402-docs-15, coinbase-x402-supp-5, coinbase-x402-supp-7). Missing for 10: direct evidence of a conversational/natural-language interface for configuring or operating the protocol itself (it's exposed as HTTP/API/tool-call primitives, not literal NL commands), and no independent hands-on report of an agent conversationally driving the full pay-and-settle flow.
